description: This file is a shell script designed to launch a web browser to display an HTML page describing a git command. It handles various browser configurations, options, and environments to ensure compatibility and flexibility.

methods.name: valid_custom_tool
methods.description: Checks if a custom browser tool command is valid by querying git configuration.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Validates if a given tool name is recognized as a supported browser.

methods.name: init_browser_path
methods.description: Initializes the browser path based on git configuration or defaults, particularly for chromium.
